title: Florida Sunbiz New Business Leads Input

daysBack.title: Daily files
daysBack.description: How many of the latest Sunbiz daily filing files to read (one per business day). 1 = the newest day.

entityTypes.title: Entity types
entityTypes.description: Options: llc, corporation, nonprofit, limited_partnership, foreign_llc, foreign_corporation, foreign_nonprofit, foreign_limited_partnership, trust. Empty = all types.

cities.title: Cities
cities.description: Principal or mailing city, e.g. MIAMI, ORLANDO, TAMPA. Empty = statewide.

zipCodes.title: ZIP codes or prefixes
zipCodes.description: e.g. 33101 or 331 (all ZIPs starting 331). Empty = any.

nameKeywords.title: Name contains
nameKeywords.description: Keep businesses whose name contains any of these, e.g. ROOFING, CLEANING, TRUCKING, DENTAL.

excludeKeywords.title: Name excludes
excludeKeywords.description: Drop businesses whose name contains any of these, e.g. HOLDINGS, INVESTMENTS.

excludeAgentServiceAddresses.title: Skip agent-service addresses
excludeAgentServiceAddresses.description: Drop filings whose principal address is a registered-agent service (Northwest, Incorp, LegalZoom...), which is not where the business operates.

requireOfficer.title: Require a named person
requireOfficer.description: Only filings that list at least one person as officer, manager or member.

maxRows.title: Max businesses
maxRows.description: Cap on rows returned. Controls cost.
